overview_description.description: F2 is the compounding intelligence platform for private markets. Built on Adam, Deal Intelligence, and Institutional Knowledge, F2 transforms a firm's deal history into a persistent, queryable knowledge asset and evaluates every new opportunity with complete context: precedent deals, live data room files, and third-party market data. From screening to underwriting and portfolio monitoring, the platform is powered by an Excel-native financial analysis engine, auditable at every layer, and orchestrated by agents that carry context across the firm's complete deal universe. F2's approach is centered around delivering better capabilities on complex finance workflows without compromising on security. Headquartered in New York City, F2 is backed by leading investors including HighlandX, Left Lane Capital, NFX, Y Combinator, and Torch Capital. To learn more or request a demo, visit f2.ai.
